title: Port footer pages to zola
body:
- [x] Security Disclosure Policy (simple page, no specific template)
- [x] Security Hall of Fame (specific template to pull data from a toml with date, project, name of reporter, link for reporter, and markdown summary of the vulnerability)
- [x] Legal (simple section, no specific template?)
  - [x] Privacy Notice (simple page, no specific template)
  - [x] Terms and Conditions (simple page, no specific template)
  - [x] Code of Conduct (simple page, no specific template)
  - [x] Copyright Notice (simple page, no specific template)
 - [x] Contact
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
